name: Terrik
description: A disgraced Selesnyan elven wurmcaller who accidentally collapsed the Basilica of the Opportune with his wurm and tries to redeem himself by helping the orphan Bazda and his friends.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin tells Terrik to forgive himself, and he hides a wurm under his bed while telling her the neighbors' wurm sightings are over-meditation.
timeline.quote: do you really think I'd be able to fit a half-grown wurm under my bed?

timeline.summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
timeline.quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

timeline.summary: Children at the orphanage recognize Terrik as the wurmcaller who destroyed the basilica, and Bazda defends him with a hairpin.
timeline.quote: Bazda pulls a six-inch hairpin from her right bun and jabs it at the punk

timeline.summary: Bazda shows Terrik an ancient crescent artifact her father found at the basilica, and Terrik promises to have Ambrellin look at it.
timeline.quote: My father gave me this a couple days before he died.

timeline.summary: Bazda steals Terrik's shears and follows him home to the Selesnyan cooperative.
timeline.quote: It's only fair I hold something valuable of yours.

timeline.summary: Savaryn announces his promotion and that he and Kellim will move away, upsetting Terrik.
timeline.quote: We're not commuting,

timeline.summary: Terrik proposes one last adventure and reveals his young wurm is his bed; the friends reluctantly agree to explore beneath the basilica.
timeline.quote: Not quite. The wurm is the bed.

timeline.summary: Terrik's wurm tunnels them to the catacombs beneath the basilica, where a trap statue pulls Ambrellin into a passage; the wurm bolts and the floor collapses.
timeline.quote: Then the entire floor gives out, and there's nowhere for us to go but down.

timeline.summary: Stuck, Ambrellin finally admits she is angry and tells Terrik his friends are leaving because of his behavior; Terrik walks away alone.
timeline.quote: Okay I'm angry with you, are you happy?

timeline.summary: Terrik finds an Orzhov pontiff using abused wurms and spirits to dig for a missing piece of an Izzet coin machine.
timeline.quote: Faster! It's got to be buried around here somewhere,

timeline.summary: A rat startles Savaryn, waking the gargoyles, and the pontiff captures Terrik and Savaryn, forcing them to sign indenture contracts.
timeline.quote: Sign it or become wurm food.

timeline.summary: Terrik learns the machine mints gold from copper and meets Bazda's mother among the spirits, bound by contract.
timeline.quote: You're Bazda's mother?

timeline.summary: Terrik and Savaryn tear up the pontiff's contract book, but the pontiff restores it and questions Terrik under a verity spell.
timeline.quote: Then the pontiff reaches down into the mist and pulls back a perfectly bound book, pages all intact.

timeline.summary: Bazda secretly passes her artifact to Terrik as the pontiff searches the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Her quick thieving hands had planted it on me without me even noticing.

timeline.summary: A captive wurm collapses from the pontiff's pain magic, and Terrik, recognizing it as one of his own, plans revenge with Bazda's mother's help.
timeline.quote: He's one of mine, I know it.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a statue and with Bazda's mother's help, Terrik hurls the pontiff into the pit and tears up the contracts; the thrull jumps in after him.
timeline.quote: I pitch him into the hole.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin repairs the coin mill with Bazda's artifact and Savaryn pushes it, producing gold to pay off everyone's debts.
timeline.quote: The first gold coin tumbles out the chute, and I catch it in my hands.

timeline.summary: The pontiff returns with the thrull fused to his leg, but Terrik pays off the debts and the contracts release, freeing the spirits.
timeline.quote: I'm paying off all of our debts. We are no longer bound to your contracts.

timeline.summary: The group escapes on the wurm through molten rock with weaving healing spells, and Bazda is reunited with her parents.
timeline.quote: Mama? Papa?

timeline.summary: Terrik returns Bazda's artifact via Ambrellin and the friends find Terrik's wurm asleep in the neighbors' bed.
timeline.quote: Looks like she found her way back home, give or take a floor.

relations.quote: Oh, you're going to be in debt to my family for generations.

pages_say.description: A disgraced Selesnyan elven wurmcaller who accidentally collapsed the Basilica of the Opportune with his wurm and tries to redeem himself by helping the orphan Bazda and his friends.
